device.model: SHD-8000 / SAB 220 XWindow (System ID 06020A00, v1.6.17 gisclub.tv build)
device.type: DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, CI slot, 4-digit LED display and Ethernet
device.demod: ALi S3501 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x33
device.tuner: Airoha AV2011 DVB-S2 on SCB0/SCB1 at I2C 0x60

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / SAB (gisclub.tv XWindow mod)
source.note: Archive amiko_220_xwindowr_sab_1.6.17_gisclub.tv.rar from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as M3602 with chip ID 0x3602 (chips/m3602.py, lemontree_decoder.py, run_dump_amiko_220_xwindow_1617_app_starts.py, run_dump_amiko_220_xwindow_1617_capture_screen.py): the "M3602B 1.1.6" bootloader exchanges CRC-16/XMODEM frames with the Lemontree EuP standby and 4-digit LED MCU at I2C 0x28 on bit-banged GPIO 62 (SCL) / 171 (SDA) (" ON " -> "    " -> "boot"), prints "APP  init ok", and unpacks maincode(AV) to 0x80008000.  The application prints "---nim 3501 a-=[1]--type=[0x350100c0]----", configures the ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 and Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and draws its XWindow SAB OSD dialog through GeM3602.

desc: Amiko SHD-8000 / SAB 220 XWindow (v1.6.17 by gisclub.tv, System ID 06020A00) 4 MB SPI firmware for the ALi M3602B DVB-S2 Full HD satellite receiver.

Drives a 4-digit 7-segment LED display via the Lemontree EuP MCU on GPIO 62 / 171 (" ON " -> "boot"), ALi S3501 demodulator at I2C 0x33, Airoha AV2011 tuner at I2C 0x60, and a 40-entry 0x99xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
